text_block_list.name: Croce
text_block_list.text: Come on, everyone! Make sure to run away with all of your might!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあみなさんっ！
力の限り逃げますよーっ！

text_block_list.name: People of Gio Teogonia
text_block_list.text: G-Got it! Ohhhhh!!!
text_block_list.orig_name: ジオ・テオゴニアの民たち
text_block_list.orig_text: おおおーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: As if I'd let you get away just like that! COME OUT!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃がすかってのっ！！
出てこいっ！！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Anemone
text_block_list.text: ...Kh! These are... Gio Gehenna's monsters. "Erimachirex" and the "Basilisk Grande"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──っ。
これは
ジオ・ゲヘナの魔物。
エリマキレックスに
バジリスク・グランデ──

text_block_list.name: Croce
text_block_list.text: Uweeeh?! A Gedon and a Lust Dragon are also with them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーっ！
ゲドンも、
ラストドラゴンもいますよっ！

text_block_list.name: Monstron 1
text_block_list.text: ...! No, we won't run away!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
いや、
俺たちは逃げねえっ！！

text_block_list.name: Monstron 2
text_block_list.text: With all you young ladies working so hard for our sakes, how could we do something as shameful as deserting in the face of the enemy! EVERYONE! ISN'T THAT RIGHT?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
若い姉さん方が頑張ってんのに、
敵前逃亡なんて恥ずかしいことできるかよ！
みんなっ、
そうだろ！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Heheh, not bad! You Gio Gehenna guys are so reliable at times like these, even though you were captured just a moment ago!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふんっ、
やるじゃない！
さっきまで捕まってたっていうのに
こういうとき、
あんたらジオ・ゲヘナの連中は頼りになるわね！

text_block_list.name: Monstron 1
text_block_list.text: Heh, that's obvious!! Hailing from Gio Gehenna, we are its brave warriors!! RIGHT, GUYS?!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ、
あたりめぇだろ！！
俺たちは勇敢な
ジオ・ゲヘナの戦士だ！！
だよなあお前ら！！

text_block_list.name: People of Gio Gehenna
text_block_list.text: OOOOOHHHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_name: ジオ・ゲヘナの民たち
text_block_list.orig_text: おおっ！！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...Korokorokoro. Splendid, truly splendid. Those spirits are admirable indeed. My loyal soldiers, forged in our land of Purgatory...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──コロコロコロ。
善哉、
善哉。
その意気や良し。
其れでこそ煉獄の地にて鍛え上げられた兵どもよ──

text_block_list.name: Erimachirex
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Monstron 1
text_block_list.text: Heh, heh heh... Come on, come at me... We've smashed big freaks like you... plenty of times before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ、
へへっ……
来いよ、
かかって来い……
俺たちはおめェらみたいなデカブツなんざ
何度も
ぶっ倒してきたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Monstron 1
text_block_list.text: ......Kh! Uuu... Stop it......! What's wrong with me...!? It's simply pathetic, so stop trembling...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ。
うう……
止まれ……！　
どうしたんだ俺…っ！
情けねえぞ
震えるな……っ！

text_block_list.name: Monstron 2
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not scared at all, I'm trembling with excitement...! We were born into a world where the strong prey on the weak! Don't freak out... Fight!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
怖くなんてねえ、
これは武者震いだ……！
弱肉強食の世界で生まれた俺たちだ！
ビビるな……
戦えっ！！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...My subjects...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──
あ奴ら──

text_block_list.name: Basilisk Grande
text_block_list.text: Pweeeew!
text_block_list.orig_name: バジリスク・グランデ
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ピューーーイッ！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: ...Is something wrong? To lose focus in the midst of battle is most unwise for you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
どうしました？
戦いの最中に、
気を逸らすなど……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Ah, no. I pray forgiveness. Seeing the state of my people, I was momentarily distracted. I found myself reflecting upon my own shortcomings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──あいや、
申し訳御座いませぬ。
我が民草の有り様を見るに、
些とばかり。
自らの不徳を省みて候。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: That I did not even notice their terror... In truth, I am naught but an imitator. Unworthy of the title of "Princess".
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ奴らが畏れを抱き
震えておる事に気づかぬとは。
所詮わっちも人の猿真似──
媛失格でありんす。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: My people, I apologize for my own lack of vision. Escape immediately! Put your own lives first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
相済まなんだ、
皆の衆。
今すぐに逃げなんし──！
己が命を第一に──

text_block_list.name: Gedon
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Monstron 1
text_block_list.text: Guh, ah... Ow... I don't wanna...!!! I-I won't falter! COME AT ME!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ、
ぁ……
痛っ……
たく
ねぇ……！！！
……ひ、
怯むな！
迎え撃てーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Monstron 2
text_block_list.text: We're... WARRIORS OF Gio Gehenna!! If you ask us to run away from a fight... WE'D RATHER STAND HERE AND DIE AS WARRIORS!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちは……
ジオ・ゲヘナの戦士だ！！
逃げ帰るくらいなら、
戦士として死ぬんだ！！！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Yet again, I have erred in what I ought to reflect upon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──省みるべき仕儀を、
違えておりんした。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: ...What a reckless battle! If we do not evacuate them at once, they will really die! Princess Nephy Nella~
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
無謀な戦いを！
早く彼らを逃がさなければ
死んでしまいます！
ネフィ＝ネラ媛──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: EVERYONE, PAY HEED! KEEP YOUR EYES ON THINE FUTURE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
皆の者！
その儘前を向きなんし！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Princess Nephy Nella...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！
ネフィ＝ネラ媛……！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: I do not comprehend envy, nor do I understand fear. And yet... the sight of my people all standing firm, even while trembling, shines more brilliantly than I can bear. Therefore, I shall protect your bravery.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっちには、
嫉妬のみならず、
畏れと云ふものが判らぬ。
然れど畏れて尚、
立ち向かわんとす皆の姿──
輝かしく見えてならぬ。
なればわっちは、
その勇心を護らん。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: O'warriors of mine, follow my lead. Let those trembling legs of yours carry you forward. Together, we shall put an end to those monsters...
text_block_list.orig_text:
皆の者、
我が背について参れ。
震える足を前に進め、
共に魔物を討ち払わんぞ──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ..."Unwavering". That is the "pride" of my country!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──『不退転』。
それこそが
我が国の矜持なり！

text_block_list.name: People of Gio Gehenna
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOHHHHHHHH!!!!
text_block_list.orig_name: ジオ・ゲヘナの民たち
text_block_list.orig_text: オオオオオっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: "Unwavering"...
text_block_list.orig_text: 『不退転』……

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: They changed... the eyes of the people of Gio Gehenna have regained their color...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……変わった。
ジオ・ゲヘナの民の目の色が──

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: ...Not to be protected, nor to run. To fight alongside their Princess... That is the way they wish to live.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……守られることでも、
逃がされることでもなく。
媛とともに戦うこと──
それが、
彼らの望む在り方、
なのですね。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: In a land where might makes right, where survival itself is harsh, a pride has been tempered deep within their hearts...
text_block_list.orig_text:
弱肉強食を旨とし、
過酷な大地に暮らす人々の、
心の底に育まれし矜持……

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: ...Then, what of my people of Gio Teogonia...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
では。
ジオ・テオゴニアの民は……

text_block_list.name: Erimachirex
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Monstron 1
text_block_list.text: Gwah!! Damn it, I'm not done yet~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐわっ！！
くそ、
まだ
まだ──

text_block_list.name: Monstron 1
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I can't move... What's wrong with me? This isn't right! Move! Move, me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐう……
体が
動かねえ……っ
どうした、
こんなもんじゃねえだろ！？
動けっ！　
動け
俺っ！

text_block_list.name: Halfling Woman
text_block_list.text: No! Don't move. I'll treat you right away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
動いちゃダメ。
いま手当てをするから。

text_block_list.name: Monstron 1
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, you... Why are you doing this...?! Thinking of helping others at such a time is insane!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おい
お前……
何でこんなことしてるんだ……！？
こんな時に人助けなんて
正気の沙汰じゃねえっ！

text_block_list.name: Giant Man
text_block_list.text: Hehe, from our perspective, we think you guys are the weird ones, going after such scary monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへ、
俺たちからしたら、
あんな怖え魔物に向かってく
あんたらのほうがおかしいと思うけどな。

text_block_list.name: Giant Man
text_block_list.text: Even now, I'm scared and feel like I want to run away. But... But, even so! That doesn't mean we can just run away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今だって怖いし
逃げたいって気持ちもある。
でもよ……
でもよ！　
だからって
自分たちだけ逃げられるかよ！

text_block_list.name: Halfling Woman
text_block_list.text: Even if I'm scared right now! I don't want to abandon those in need and run away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たとえ怖かったとしても。
けが人を見捨てて逃げるなんて、
したくないの！

text_block_list.name: Halfling Woman
text_block_list.text: We may not be good at fighting... but we can support someone's determination. Even if we don't understand it, even if we're not strong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちは、
戦いは
苦手だけど……
誰かの決意を支えることはできる。
分からなくても、
たとえ強くなくても！

text_block_list.name: Giant Man
text_block_list.text: Your determination to overcome fear and fight... WE WON'T LET IT GO TO WASTE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたちが恐怖をねじ伏せて、
戦うって
決めた決意を……
無駄になんてさせない！

text_block_list.name: Halfling Woman
text_block_list.text: That is who we are... the people of Gio Teogonia! Now, I'm done with the first aid. Let's do our best together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが、
私たち……
ジオ・テオゴニアの民よ。
さあ、
応急手当はできた。
お互いに──
最善を尽くしましょう。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! This is Gio Teogonia's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ああ。
これが、
ジオ・テオゴニアの──

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It seems I was the one who needed reminding. That is precisely what makes them my people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしの方が
気付かされてしまいましたね。
それでこそ
わが国民です。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Gio Teogonia is home to a wide variety of races... many of which have different bodies in different sizes and shapes. It is a country where people with different appearances and values ​​live.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジオ・テオゴニアは
多種多様な……
体の大きさや形が違う
多くの種族が住んでいる。
容姿も価値観も、
異なる人々の暮らす国。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: That is why a culture of respecting others and coexisting in harmony was born. People of different races respect each other and cooperate with each other. Sometimes, they are even willing to risk their lives to help others.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからこそ
他者を敬い、
和をもって共存する文化が生まれた。
種族が異なる人々を尊重し、
協力し合い。
ときに、
命を張って助けることができる。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Joining hands beyond races, status and position... That is the "pride" of Gio Teogonia -- "Harmony".
text_block_list.orig_text:
国を、
身分を、
立場を超えて
手を携える──
すなわち。
ジオ・テオゴニアの矜持は──
『調和』

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: "Supreme Lava Steak"...
text_block_list.orig_text: 『至高の溶岩ステーキ』──

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: "Ultimate Rainbow Tart"...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 『至高の虹色タルト』──

text_block_list.name: Lyrael Nephy Nella
text_block_list.text: I shall dig in!
text_block_list.orig_name: ライラエル・ネフィ＝ネラ
text_block_list.orig_text: 「「いただきます」」

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: What are you waiting for, you monsters! Hurry up and kill th--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら魔物ども！
さっさと全員踏み潰──

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: ...Hah!? This light... It's the same as the one back then with Violet...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！？
この光……
ヴァイオレットの時と同じ……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: A land of Purgatory where fierce monsters and monsterfolk alike roam free. Gio Gehenna. In my world ruled by survival of the fittest, the strong represent justice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
猛き魔物が跳梁跋扈せし
煉獄の地、
ジオ・ゲヘナ。
弱肉強食の此の世では
強き者こそが正義也。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Yet strength is not forged by muscle alone. Its true essence lies in a will that never breaks... an unwavering spirit. Though I am no "human", I shall devote myself to protecting that resolve.
text_block_list.orig_text:
然れど、
強さとは腕っ節のみならず。
肝心要は、
決して折れぬ
不退転の精神にあり申す。
此の身は“ひとでなし”なれど、
只管に
その精神を守護らん。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Like a raging demon, it burns fierce and sublime. Like a Buddha, it bestows boundless mercy. A demon's visage, a Buddha's heart. Here I stand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
鬼神の如く、
凄絶に壮大に燃え盛り。
御仏の如く、
深甚に仁恕領ろしめす。
──鬼面仏心、
此処に在り。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: A dreamlike fantasy land. Gio Teogonia. In my world where a wide variety of races live, there is no conflict. Everyone recognizes, respects and joins hands with one another.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢に見える幻想の地、
ジオ・テオゴニア。
多種多様な種族が暮らすこの世界に
争いなどなく。
皆が皆を認め合い、
尊重し、
手を取り合う。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Those countless hearts are gathered into a single vessel... a country. Like a parfait layered with every kind of sweetness, they give rise to a harmony both rich and whole.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのたくさんの心が、
国という一つの器に納まる。
あらゆる甘味を集めたパフェのように、
大いなる調和を生み出す。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Sweet of Perfect. Soft and gentle, like pale white sugar. Let the love overflowing within me be poured upon everyone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──スイート・オブ・パルフェクト。
淡い白砂糖のように、
優しく嫋やかに。
この身に溢れる愛を、
皆に注ぎましょう──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: I am Nephy Nella. Gio Gehenna's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
我が名はネフィ＝ネラ。
ジオ・ゲヘナの──

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: My name is Lyrael. Representing Gio Teogonia...
text_block_list.orig_text:
我が名はライラエル。
ジオ・テオゴニアの──

text_block_list.name: Nephy Nella Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Princess." "I am the Princess!
text_block_list.orig_name: ネフィ＝ネラ・ライラエル
text_block_list.orig_text:
「プリンセスなり」
「プリンセスです！」

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: HOGYAWAH!? T-They both have new forms?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほぎゃわっ！
み、
みなたまの姿がっ！？

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: I-In that case, it's time for me to chant "Quantum Infinity" to help those monsters~!! Honeyney~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こうなりゃ魔物たまたちに、
『量子∞インフィニティー』を唱えるハニよ～！！
ハニニ～～～っ！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: All right, it's a huge success! Everyone's become super huge, honey! Like this they'll crush the Princesses and their friends with ease, honey~!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし大成功っ！
みんな超巨大化したハニーっ！
このままプリンセスたちを踏みつぶしちゃうハニ～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: White Lightning... SUNRISE!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──箭雷夜天！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Omniform Transformation: Demon-God Buddha Palm!
text_block_list.orig_text:
天元万化・
鬼神仏掌──

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Kannagara Isana-oroshi...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
かんながら・
ゐさなをろし……！

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 「「「はああああっ！！！」」」

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Uh-hyah... What am I looking at...? Are living gods fighting...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっひゃー……
なにあれ、
神々の戦い……？

text_block_list.name: Croce
text_block_list.text: Other than the intense light, sound, and vibration, I couldn't sense anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい光と、
音と、
振動以外、
何も感知できませんでしたよーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: TH-TH-TH-TH... THEY WERE DISPATCHED IN AN INSTANT, HONEY BUNNY!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
し……
しし……
瞬殺されたハニバニーっっっ！！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...Daughter of the "Bee". This is the end of your rampage. The outcome of this battle is already settled.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──蜂の娘よ。
貴様の狼藉も此れ迄ぞ。
疾うに勝負は決している故に。

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Don't screw with me...! Awakening like that without my permission... AS IF I'D LET THIS EEEEEEEEEND!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふざけんなっ！
あたしに許可なく勝手に覚醒とか
してんじゃねぇーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: Melissa-tama?!
text_block_list.orig_text: メリッサたま！？

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Uu... Guuuu! AAAAAHHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う……
ぐううっ！
ああ
あああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: ......! An abnormally powerful amplification... What is going on...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ。
異常なほどの力の増幅……
これは一体っ……

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: あああああああああああッッ！！！

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: *pant pant*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: Melissa-tama... That appearance...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
メリッサたま、
その姿は……！？

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Huh? My appearance? ...Kyaha! KYAHAHAHAHAHA! What's this now?! It seems I also have "awakened", haven't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え。
姿？
……………………
きゃはっ、
きゃははは！
なになに！？　
これって、
覚醒だよねっ？

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Isn't this just what I needed? Right, Honey Honey-chan? My whole body is hot and tingling, and I feel invincible!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コレはコレでアリじゃね？　
ね、
ハニハニちゃん？
身体中熱くって、
ヒリヒリしてて、
無敵ってかんじがする！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… power that far exceeds one’s vessel…
To desire strength beyond what you can bear
is even more unmanageable than a babe yearning for the moon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フム……
器をはるかに超えたる力……
汝が身に余る強さを需るなど、
月を欲しがる赤子よりも手に負えぬ。

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Kyahaha... Power is welling up inside me... I can become even stronger. ENOUGH TO TWIST AND CRUSH ALL OF YOU...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃは……
力が湧き上がってくる……
あたしは、
もっともっと強くなれるんだ。
お前たちなんてひねりつぶせるくらいに……！

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm the strongest... Worthy of ruling over the entire world, the most peerless and magnificent Queen bee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
あたしは。
この世界を、
全部まとめて支配するのにふさわしい、
最強の女王蜂なんだから──

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Ugh... My head hurts like hell, though... But now... I can wipe you all out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う──
ぅ……
アタマ、
死ぬほど痛い……
けどっ……
今ならおまえらを全滅させられる──！

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: PREPARE YOURSELF FOR...
text_block_list.orig_text: 覚悟しなさ……

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: No... You can't, honey...!! Any more and you will...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だめ……
だめハニ……っ！！
それ以上はっ！

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: MELISSA-CHAN, DOOOOOOOOON'T!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
メリッサちゃん、
だめ～～～っ！！！

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Uh... Ugh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う……
ううっ！

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: You're back...! Melissa-chan, are you okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
戻った……っ！
メリッサちゃん大丈夫っ！？

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Huh... Me? Just now, did I... ugh, it hurts...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
あたし？　
今
何か……
うっ、
痛……っ。

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: Melissa-tama... Melissa-chan! Let's stop! At this rate, you will...
text_block_list.orig_text:
メリッサたま……
メリッサちゃん！
もうやめようよっ！
このままじゃメリッサちゃんが……

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: *pant pant*... Okay... I'll stop...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
分かった……
もう、
やめる……

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: This is more than enough... I DON'T NEED NO SLAVE ANYMORE...! I'LL SCATTER THE MOST POWERFUL POISON I KNOW ALL OVER THE SKY SO YOU WILL ALL DIE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もういい………
もう、
ドレイなんて要らない……！
空から
いっ
ちばん強い猛毒ばら撒いて、
全員即死させてやる！

text_block_list.name: Honey Honey-chan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah?! WAIT, MELISSA-CHAN!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──っ！？
待って、
メリッサちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: This is troubling! She is going to escape through the sky...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いけません！　
空に逃げられてしまいますわ……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I won't let you!
text_block_list.orig_text: させませんっ！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! PRINCESS PECORINE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ペコリーヌ姫！！

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: ...!? You, what... are you grabbing my leg!? Or rather, why are you here... how!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！？
あんた……
なに足掴んでんのよ！
ってか、
なんでここに……
あんたがいんのよ！？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ehe... It's a little secret☆ I won't let you just go and do as you please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
内緒です☆
このまま好き勝手はさせませんよ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...It's about time you and I settled things...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あなたとの決着は、
わたしがつけますから……！

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: Dammit, let me go! You're making it hard to fly...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クソっ、
放せ！
飛びにくい……っ！

text_block_list.name: Melissa
text_block_list.text: HUUUH?! D-Don't be ridiculous! You're in the way! FALL!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ！？　
ふ、
ふざけんなっ！
邪魔！　
落ちろっ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}くんっ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!!! We'll definitely save everyone!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
はいっ！！！
絶対にみなさんを
助けます！！
